rootCause: A later partial GitHub Pages publisher downloaded an older validated-production-site artifact and overlaid only selected sector and discovery files. The deployment replaced the complete Pages artifact without copying the ai-search directory, although ai-search/index.html remained present on main.
remediation: assemble Pages from the complete current public repository surface
require ai-search page, runtime assets, manifest, coverage report and vector shards
run a scheduled repair guard that redeploys only when the live route is absent or stale
